books.title: Baby Jesus Is Missing
books.summary: Early in December, Nativity figures begin disappearing across Reedy River. When a $500 reward is offered for catching the thief, Catherine and Susanna Mae decide to investigate. What begins as a Christmas mystery soon becomes a test of their judgment.

endorsement.quote: One mark of a good children’s book is that it delights adults as well. I found *Baby Jesus Is Missing* to be such a book. Author Michael LaPenna introduces us to sisters Catherine and Susanna Mae as they solve the local town crime of the stolen baby Jesus figurines while also introducing us to the slang of the criminal and detective world in hilarious jaunts of language. The girls soon discover that one’s vocation, even crime solving, requires faith, virtue, and sacrifice. This is a fun faith-filled teaching story, full of surprises, and part of a book series that helps us all find the Baby Jesus and keep him in our lives.
endorsement.name: Kiki Latimer
endorsement.credit: Catholic author and host of *The Catholic Bookworm*

books.title: The Offering
books.summary: While visiting their grandparents in the mountains, Catherine and Susanna Mae discover a rusted tin full of money. Then their border collie, Atticus, chases a bear cub into woods their grandfather has warned them to avoid. Should they obey his warning or go after their dog?

books.title: Angelina Grace
books.summary: One autumn afternoon, Catherine meets Ulga, a young woman living alone in a secluded hollow outside town. As the sisters get to know her, they begin to wonder about her circumstances and what they can do to help her stay safe.

endorsement.quote: Michael LaPenna has given us a charming mystery story that unfolds the deeper mysteries about growing up, caring for others and learning to forgive and be reconciled. Join Susanna Mae and her sister Catherine as they solve the mystery of the strange girl in the woods and the stranger men who are searching for her. Written with clear simplicity, LaPenna has a gift for story telling that will attract and absorb the attention of young readers.
endorsement.name: Fr. Dwight Longenecker
endorsement.credit: author of *Immortal Combat* and *Beheading Hydra* and the blog *Standing on My Head*

books.title: Haddie’s Locket
books.tagline: A story about a family keepsake
books.summary: When the girls’ great-grandmother Haddie comes to visit, Catherine borrows her locket while Haddie is away on a short trip, and the locket goes missing. It is the last keepsake Haddie has of her late husband. Catherine dreads telling her, until an old map leads to an adventure and a possible way to make things right.

books.title: Laura’s Locker
books.tagline: A story about telling the truth
books.summary: Susanna Mae sees a classmate framed for cheating. She knows what happened, but speaking up could cost her a friendship. During a visit to her grandparents in Gloucester, Massachusetts, she encounters mysterious woods and old legends. Back at school, the harder challenge remains.

endorsement.quote: Michael LaPenna invites young readers into a compelling encounter with conscience, courage, and grace. *Laura’s Locker* reveals how faith strengthens the heart to confront injustice, embrace truth, and discover the healing power of authentic friendship.
endorsement.name: Dr. Sebastian Mahfood, OP
endorsement.credit: author of *The Narrative Spirituality of Dante’s Divine Comedy*
